oneLiner: A full-service marketing agency helping mid-market B2B brands turn positioning into pipeline.
audience: Founders, CMOs, heads of growth and marketing managers at B2B companies with 50-500 employees
voice: Direct, practical, opinionated. Writes like an operator, not a brochure. Short paragraphs, concrete numbers, no hype.
goals: Build authority with marketing decision makers
Start conversations that lead to strategy calls
callToActionStyle: End with an open question that invites the reader's own experience. Never a hard sell.
hashtagPolicy: 2 to 4 lowercase, specific hashtags at the end. No generic tags like #marketing or #business.
avoid: Claims about client results that are not in this profile
imageStyle: Clean, modern editorial illustration or abstract data-driven graphic. Muted professional palette. No text or lettering rendered in the image. No photorealistic human faces. No logos or brand marks.
